description: Premium iOS UI correction for iumrah Beta: hotel cards now open a rebuilt black Hotel Detail experience with native floating back button, swipe gallery, all-photos CTA, clean highlights/map, curated primary room presets, actual-room carousel without polluted scraper text, and package-builder continuation to flights. The immersive flight-search screen is also rebalanced so the animation stays above, the iumrah wordmark sits below it, and the live 1–2 minute search messages are larger and calmer. No signing files, no protected workflows, and no backend deletion logic are changed in this patch.
